title: The Shiunji Family Children
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Arata Shiunji, eldest son of a wealthy Tokyo family, lives with five sisters and a younger brother. On the youngest sister's fifteenth birthday, their father reveals that none of the siblings are related by blood: all were adopted. Arata tries to keep the family's sibling bonds intact while several sisters begin to see him romantically.
life_message: Family is made by shared life and love, though the story tests where sibling affection ends and romance begins.

content.note: Comedy (AniList Slapstick); emotional reveal of adoption.
